Why Cyprus, in numbers

The case writes itself.

0%

tax on foreign dividends & interest under the non-dom regime

12.5%

corporate tax, one of the lowest in the EU

~2mo

typical processing for permanent residency by investment

300+

days of sunshine a year on the Mediterranean

Figures are indicative and subject to individual circumstances. Full guides carry current detail and a note to seek professional tax advice.

How it works

Simple, from the first hello.

No jargon, no pressure, and never getting lost in a foreign system alone. Three steps, and we are with you through all of them.

01

Talk

A free discovery call. We listen to what you want from Cyprus, answer anything, and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.

02

Plan

We build a clear plan around your goals, timeline and budget, whether that is a move, an investment, or both.

03

Handled

We handle it on the ground: property, vetted vendors, paperwork, residency and arrival. You land, and everything simply works.
